name: veyra-analysis-agent
description: LiveKit agent worker that silently transcribes each meeting participant and, once the meeting ends, scores them on 5 parameters via Groq — written to the same database the main Veyra app reads on the host's meeting-ended screen.

scripts.dev: prisma generate && tsx watch src/agent.ts dev
scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/generated', 'dist/generated', { recursive: true })"
